description: Docker containerization, project documentation, and final integration. Create Docker setup for both services, docker-compose for local development, README with setup instructions, and ensure end-to-end integration works.
steps: Create backend/Dockerfile - Python 3.11 slim, install requirements, run with uvicorn
Create frontend/Dockerfile - Node 22 for build stage, nginx for serving static files
Create docker-compose.yml at project root with services: backend (FastAPI), frontend (React/nginx), db (PostgreSQL 16)
Create .env.example with all required environment variables documented
Create README.md with: project description, tech stack, prerequisites, setup instructions (local and Docker), API documentation reference, project structure overview
Create backend/app/core/init_db.py script to seed initial admin user and default roles on first run
Create .gitignore for Python, Node, and Docker artifacts
Ensure backend/alembic/ is properly configured to run migrations on startup or via command
Verify docker-compose up builds and starts all services correctly
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose build completes successfully for all services
README.md documents complete setup process for local development and Docker
.env.example lists all required environment variables with descriptions
Project structure is clean and well-organized
verification: Verify README.md exists and contains setup instructions
